elements.evidence: Section 22.14 restricts only M&I from soliciting Customer's employees and imposes no restriction on Customer.
The restriction is one-way and applies only to M&I.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: The clause covers all employees of Customer, without limiting coverage to personnel directly involved in the Services.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: The restriction applies throughout the Agreement's Term rather than for no more than 12 months after each person's involvement ends.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no exclusion for general advertisements.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no exclusion for unsolicited approaches.

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The operative language prohibits solicitation only and does not prohibit hiring.
